reviews.text: I bring my corgi here for a full groom every few months and it’s always an excellent experience! I wouldn’t trust anyone else with grooming services. Easy booking, friendly and kind staff, and my corgi always comes home smiling and looking refreshed!

First picture is what we asked for (a photo from his previous groom elsewhere) and second photo is how he came home. Needless to say it was not what we were expecting, especially after communicating multiples times we did not want him shaved/ short. Also what the heck is going on with that tail??? 😭 We asked them just to trim the top. Added an extra star because everyone was actually very nice despite the outcome.
